San Patricio County, seated at Sinton, sits on Corpus Christi Bay and hosts major petrochemical and export infrastructure, including Cheniere's Corpus Christi LNG terminal and shipbuilding/fabrication yards at Ingleside and Portland. Grain sorghum and cotton farming continue on the county's inland acreage, but industrial and port-related development along the coast now drives most commercial real estate activity. Its position just across the bay from Corpus Christi also feeds residential and retail spillover from that metro.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: November 8, 2026
